mapper.insert: insert into ai_message (conversation_id, user_id, role, content, content_type, tool_name, action_type, tool_result, audit_status, audit_remark, approval_status, approval_remark, approval_user_id, approval_time, create_time) values (#{conversationId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{toolName}, #{actionType}, #{toolResult}, #{auditStatus}, #{auditRemark}, #{approvalStatus}, #{approvalRemark}, #{approvalUserId}, #{approvalTime}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by id desc limit 1

select content as question, count(1) as hit_count from ai_message where role = 'user' and content is not null and trim(content) != '' group by content order by hit_count desc, max(id) desc limit #{limit}

select u.content as question, count(1) as hit_count from ai_message u inner join ai_message a on a.id = ( select min(next_msg.id) from ai_message next_msg where next_msg.conversation_id = u.conversation_id and next_msg.id > u.id and next_msg.role = 'assistant' ) where u.role = 'user' and a.content like '%我暂时没有足够信息直接回答这个问题%' group by u.content order by hit_count desc, max(u.id) desc limit #{limit}

select a.conversation_id, u.id as user_message_id, a.id as assistant_message_id, u.content as user_question, a.content as assistant_reply, a.tool_name as route, a.action_type, case when a.action_type = 'cancel_order' then '涉及取消订单动作' when a.action_type = 'remind_order' then '涉及催单动作' when a.action_type = 'after_sale' then '涉及售后申请动作' when a.tool_name = 'action' then '命中高风险业务动作路由' when a.content like '%确认%' then '涉及用户确认的高风险业务动作' when a.content like '%取消订单%' then '涉及取消订单动作' when a.content like '%售后申请%' then '涉及售后申请动作' when a.content like '%催单%' then '涉及催单动作' else '命中高风险关键词' end as risk_reason, a.audit_status, a.audit_remark, a.approval_status, a.approval_remark, a.approval_user_id, a.approval_time, a.create_time from ai_message a left join ai_message u on u.id = ( select max(prev_msg.id) from ai_message prev_msg where prev_msg.conversation_id = a.conversation_id and prev_msg.id < a.id and prev_msg.role = 'user' ) where a.role = 'assistant' and ( a.action_type is not null or a.tool_name = 'action' or a.content like '%确认%' or a.content like '%取消订单%' or a.content like '%售后申请%' or a.content like '%催单%' ) order by a.id desc limit #{limit}

select date_format(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as stat_date, count(1) as fallback_count from ai_message u inner join ai_message a on a.id = ( select min(next_msg.id) from ai_message next_msg where next_msg.conversation_id = u.conversation_id and next_msg.id > u.id and next_msg.role = 'assistant' ) where u.role = 'user' and a.content like '%我暂时没有足够信息直接回答这个问题%' group by date_format(u.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') order by stat_date desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update ai_message set audit_status = #{auditStatus}, audit_remark = #{auditRemark} where id = #{assistantMessageId} and role = 'assistant' and ( action_type is not null or tool_name = 'action' or content like '%确认%' or content like '%取消订单%' or content like '%售后申请%' or content like '%催单%' )

update ai_message set approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, approval_remark = #{approvalRemark}, approval_user_id = #{approvalUserId}, approval_time = now() where id = #{assistantMessageId} and role = 'assistant' and ifnull(audit_status, 0) != 0 and ifnull(approval_status, 0) = 0 and ( action_type is not null or tool_name = 'action' or content like '%确认%' or content like '%取消订单%' or content like '%售后申请%' or content like '%催单%' )
